user.title: Add a unix device
user.description: Connects over SSH. Provide a password, a private-key path on the Home Assistant host (unencrypted key), or both.

host_key.title: Confirm the host key
host_key.description:
{host} identifies itself with this SSH host key:

`{fingerprint}`

To check it, run `ssh-keygen -lf {key_file}` on the host. Submit only if the fingerprints match. From now on the integration will refuse to connect if the key changes.

reauth_confirm.title: Host key changed
reauth_confirm.description:
{host} now presents a different SSH host key:

`{fingerprint}`

This is expected after reinstalling the OS or regenerating host keys. Otherwise, another machine may be answering on this address. Check the key with `ssh-keygen -lf {key_file}` on the host and submit only if it matches.

error.invalid_key: Could not read the private key (missing, or passphrase-protected)
error.no_credentials: Provide a password or a key file
error.unsupported: No supported package manager found (apt, dnf, yum, apk, pacman with pacman-contrib, zypper)
error.host_key_changed: The host key changed during setup; try again

abort.reauth_successful: The new host key was accepted
